chunks: (The Pharaoh) said: "You have come to believe without my dispensation. Surely he is your chief who taught you magic. I will have your hands and feet cut off on alternate sides and crucify you on the trunks of date-palm trees. You will come to know whose punishment is harder and protracted."
ai.seo_question: What punishment did Pharaoh threaten the Israelites with in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Taa-Ha, Pharaoh addresses the Children of Israel, identifying Musa as their leader and chief magician to justify his threat of severe corporal punishment—specifically crucifixion on palm trunks—to demonstrate the superiority of his power. Shia scholarly tradition often highlights this as a moment of political and spiritual confrontation, where Pharaoh attempts to delegitimize Musa’s divine mission by framing it as mere sorcery, thereby testing the faith of the Israelites before the final plague.
